entries.title: Genesis 9:1
segments: ¶And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

entries.title: Genesis 9:2
segments: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth [upon] the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.

entries.title: Genesis 9:3
segments: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.

words.text: for you; even as the green

entries.title: Genesis 9:4
segments: But flesh with the life thereof, [which is] the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.

entries.title: Genesis 9:5
segments: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.

entries.title: Genesis 9:6
segments: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.

entries.title: Genesis 9:7
segments: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.

entries.title: Genesis 9:8
segments: ¶And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,

entries.title: Genesis 9:9
segments: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;

words.text: with you, and with your seed

entries.title: Genesis 9:10
segments: And with every living creature that [is] with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.

words.text: that [is] with you, of the fowl
with you; from all that go out

entries.title: Genesis 9:11
segments: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.

words.text: with you; neither shall all flesh
; neither shall there any more be a flood

entries.title: Genesis 9:12
segments: ¶And God said, This [is] the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that [is] with you, for perpetual generations:

words.text: between me and you and every living

entries.title: Genesis 9:13
segments: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

words.text: , and it shall be for a token

entries.title: Genesis 9:14
segments: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:

words.text: And it shall come to pass, when I bring

entries.title: Genesis 9:15
segments: And I will remember my covenant, which [is] between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

words.text: , which [is] between me and you and every living

entries.title: Genesis 9:16
segments: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that [is] upon the earth.

words.text: ; and I will look upon it

entries.title: Genesis 9:17
segments: And God said unto Noah, This [is] the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that [is] upon the earth.

entries.title: Genesis 9:18
segments: ¶And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham [is] the father of Canaan. {Canaan: Heb. Chenaan}

entries.title: Genesis 9:19
segments: These [are] the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.

words.text: : and of them was the whole earth

entries.title: Genesis 9:20
segments: And Noah began [to be] an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:

entries.title: Genesis 9:21
segments: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.

entries.title: Genesis 9:22
segments: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.

entries.title: Genesis 9:23
segments: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid [it] upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces [were] backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.

entries.title: Genesis 9:24
segments: ¶And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.

entries.title: Genesis 9:25
segments: And he said, Cursed [be] Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.

words.text: shall he be unto his brethren

entries.title: Genesis 9:26
segments: And he said, Blessed [be] the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant. {his servant: or, servant to them}

entries.title: Genesis 9:27
segments: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant. {enlarge: or, persuade}

entries.title: Genesis 9:28
segments: ¶And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.

entries.title: Genesis 9:29
segments: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
